title: Effect of patient' serum of different timepoints on CD3 T cells at day 2 after in vitro cell culture
description: To examine the impacts of these differences in recipients’ serum on donor T-cell activation Overall design: we performed in vitro cell culture assays on T cells selected from PBMCs of healthy donor by adding patients’ peripheral serum collected at 7 am (7 am group) or 4 pm (4 pm group) for 2 days
